stimulus.title: River Park Bird Walk
stimulus.text:
RIVER PARK BIRD WALK — Saturday, May 16

Meet at the south gate at 8:40 a.m. The walk starts at 9:00 and ends at 10:30. A guide will show us how to look for birds without making them fly away.

Bring a water bottle, a pencil and a small notebook. You can borrow a pair of binoculars at the gate. Please write your name on the loan list and give them back before you leave.

During the walk, stay on the path. Speak quietly near the lake. You do not need to take photos. A useful note says where you saw a bird and what it was doing.

If it rains hard, the walk will move to the park classroom. The meeting time and place will stay the same. We will look at bird pictures and listen to recorded calls. Check the park notice before you leave home.

stimulus.title: The Quiet Corner
stimulus.text:
On Tuesday, Eli’s class started a “quiet corner” where children could read before lessons. Their teacher put some books on a low table. Eli liked the idea, but by Thursday the table was always crowded. Some children waited for a book and left when the bell rang.

Eli first planned to ask the teacher for more books. Then he watched for a few minutes. Most children picked up three or four books and had to return them one by one before they could sit down. Others could not see the names on the thin book covers.

Eli and his friend Nia made labels for three baskets: “Short Stories”, “Animals” and “Make Something”. They put a card by each basket with the names of two books children could start with. The next morning, Eli saw a child read a small book about bees for ten minutes. There were no new books on the table.

At the class meeting, the teacher asked what had helped. Eli said, “Now it takes less time to find a book.” Nia added, “Let’s change the cards next week, so children can see books they missed.”

sections.instructions: Write an email in English. Do not use your real name.

questions.prompt: You are Sam. Invite your friend Alex to a class book swap. The book swap is next Wednesday at 4:15 p.m. in Room 6. Everyone should bring one book they have finished and be ready to say why they like it. Ask Alex to reply by Monday. Write about 45–65 words.
questions.solution:
Example: Hi Alex,
Would you like to come to our class book swap? It is next Wednesday at 4:15 p.m. in Room 6. Please bring one book you have finished. Be ready to tell us why you like it. Could you let me know by Monday? I hope you can come!
Sam

说明携带一本读完的书（2 分）、准备说明喜欢的原因（2 分）以及周一前回复（2 分）。
有合适的称呼、落款，顺序清楚。
句意连贯、常用语法与拼写准确。可理解的小错酌情扣分。

blocks.title: 题 10

blocks.title: River Park Bird Walk
blocks.text:
RIVER PARK BIRD WALK — Saturday, May 16

Meet at the south gate at 8:40 a.m. The walk starts at 9:00 and ends at 10:30. A guide will show us how to look for birds without making them fly away.

Bring a water bottle, a pencil and a small notebook. You can borrow a pair of binoculars at the gate. Please write your name on the loan list and give them back before you leave.

During the walk, stay on the path. Speak quietly near the lake. You do not need to take photos. A useful note says where you saw a bird and what it was doing.

If it rains hard, the walk will move to the park classroom. The meeting time and place will stay the same. We will look at bird pictures and listen to recorded calls. Check the park notice before you leave home.

blocks.title: 题 11
blocks.text: Where should the group meet?

blocks.title: 题 12
blocks.text: How long is the bird walk on a dry day?

blocks.title: 题 13
blocks.text: What must a visitor do to borrow binoculars?

blocks.title: 题 14
blocks.text: Which note is the best example of what the guide wants?

blocks.title: 题 15
blocks.text: What will change if it rains hard?

blocks.title: The Quiet Corner
blocks.text:
On Tuesday, Eli’s class started a “quiet corner” where children could read before lessons. Their teacher put some books on a low table. Eli liked the idea, but by Thursday the table was always crowded. Some children waited for a book and left when the bell rang.

Eli first planned to ask the teacher for more books. Then he watched for a few minutes. Most children picked up three or four books and had to return them one by one before they could sit down. Others could not see the names on the thin book covers.

Eli and his friend Nia made labels for three baskets: “Short Stories”, “Animals” and “Make Something”. They put a card by each basket with the names of two books children could start with. The next morning, Eli saw a child read a small book about bees for ten minutes. There were no new books on the table.

At the class meeting, the teacher asked what had helped. Eli said, “Now it takes less time to find a book.” Nia added, “Let’s change the cards next week, so children can see books they missed.”

blocks.title: 题 16
blocks.text: What happened by Thursday?

blocks.title: 题 17
blocks.text: What did Eli think about doing first?

blocks.title: 题 18
blocks.text: What made it difficult to choose books?

blocks.title: 题 19
blocks.text: What does the sentence “There were no new books on the table” help the reader understand?

blocks.title: 题 20
blocks.text: Why does Nia suggest changing the cards next week?

blocks.title: 题 21
blocks.text: Yesterday we ___ (visit) the town library with our class.

blocks.title: 题 22
blocks.text: The reading room was quiet, so we spoke ___ (quiet).

blocks.title: 题 23
blocks.text: Tia has two story books. The first one is about friendship and the ___ (two) one is about animals.

blocks.title: 题 24
blocks.text: My friend and I booked two seats. We will go there again ___ Friday.

blocks.title: 题 25
blocks.text: Please bring your library card. Don’t ___ (forget) it!

blocks.title: 题 26
blocks.text: You are at the school gate. The music room is upstairs, on the left side of the second floor. A visitor asks, “How do I get to the music room?” Write directions.

blocks.title: 题 27
blocks.text: Your friend invites you to a game at 3:00 on Sunday. You have a swimming lesson then, but you are free at 4:00. Write a friendly reply.

blocks.title: 题 28
blocks.text: Last Sunday your family went to Green Lake. You took a bus and had lunch by the water. Write one sentence about your trip.

blocks.title: 题 29
blocks.text: The class wants to keep its reading corner tidy. A student has just finished a book. Write one clear instruction telling the student where and when to return it.

blocks.title: 题 30
blocks.text: You are Sam. Invite your friend Alex to a class book swap. The book swap is next Wednesday at 4:15 p.m. in Room 6. Everyone should bring one book they have finished and be ready to say why they like it. Ask Alex to reply by Monday. Write about 45–65 words.
